findings.title: Fallback lookup depends on database-backed SiteSetting on every miss
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList#[] calls SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym every time I18n::Backend::Fallbacks handles a missing translation. SiteSetting is database/cache backed, so translation lookups made during boot, migrations, seed/rake tasks, or when the settings table/cache is not yet available can raise or fail instead of falling back, and hot missing-translation paths repeatedly pay a settings lookup. It also raises NoMethodError if default_locale is ever nil. Capture/derive the site default without a per-lookup database-backed call, handle nil, and refresh it when the setting changes.

findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded for web requests
findings.body: Fallback locale files are loaded only from ApplicationController#set_locale via I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!. The patched backend's translate path in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb still loads only config.locale, while this codebase explicitly loads locale YAML on demand. Mailers, background jobs, rake tasks, console, and any translation performed before this before_filter therefore look up the fallback locale in a backend that has never loaded its YAML file, so they return 'translation missing' instead of the site-default/English string. Loading must happen in the translation/fallback path itself, not only in the web controller.

findings.title: Loading a fallback locale does not invalidate the translation LRU cache
findings.body: ensure_loaded!/load_locale add translations for a newly loaded locale but never clear @cache. I18n.translate caches no-argument results (including a frozen 'translation missing' result produced before the fallback locale was loaded) keyed only by key, current locale, and backend. After ensure_loaded! later loads the fallback file, subsequent lookups can keep returning the cached missing/frozen string for the life of the process (until an unrelated reload!). Clear the cache when a locale is actually loaded.

findings.title: Fallback list mixes String and Symbol locale identities
findings.body: The list is built as [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq: locale and I18n.locale are not normalized to Symbol here, so a String locale such as "de" and the Symbol :de are treated as distinct entries by uniq, by @loaded_locales.include? in the accelerator, and by backend translation hashes. That can cause duplicate fallback attempts, repeated loading of the same YAML file under a different key type, and missed loaded-checks. Normalize every entry to a Symbol (and drop nil before uniq) before returning the chain.

findings.title: No tests cover fallback ordering, loading, or pluralized fallbacks
findings.body: This change replaces the global I18n.fallbacks object, moves pluralization setup, removes config.i18n.fallbacks from production/profile, and adds on-demand fallback loading, but adds no specs. There is nothing verifying user-locale -> site-default -> :en ordering, fallback of pluralized/interpolated keys (which bypass the accelerator cache), behaviour when the site default changes, or non-request contexts. Add backend-level specs for those cases before relying on this in production.
